clue.text: Putting pleasure first ruins peace — I'm troubled

definitions.note: a noun phrase here: the practice of giving pleasure priority

indicators.note: troubled means disturbed or stirred up, so the preceding letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A grumble that hedonism wrecks tranquillity, leaving the speaker upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ruins' looks like the anagram signal, but it is fodder: RUINS, PEACE and I'M together are rearranged, signalled by 'troubled'.
explanation.definitionFit: Epicurean philosophy, as popularly understood, holds that seeking enjoyment comes before everything else.

clue.text: French father and daughter crossing the Parisian street, drunk

indicators.note: the father-and-daughter letters reach across, so they straddle the other pieces placed within them

parts.note: père is French for father
la is a French word for the

explanation.surface: A French dad and his daughter crossing a Paris road while intoxicated.
explanation.walkthrough: The French article 'la' and street are what get crossed, not the road in the surface; the father-daughter pair is split open to hold them.
explanation.definitionFit: Plastered is informal slang for very intoxicated.

clue.text: Arrive carrying cooking vessel and fruit dish

indicators.note: carrying means holding something within, so one word encloses the other

parts.note: to arrive is to come
a pot is a vessel for cooking

explanation.surface: Someone turns up bearing a saucepan and a dessert of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A compote is stewed fruit served in syrup, a classic dessert.

clue.text: Model once more about to meet actors

parts.note: re means about or concerning
the cast is the set of actors in a production

explanation.surface: A director reshaping a play is about to meet the performers.
explanation.definitionFit: To recast is to shape or mould something again, as with metal in a mould.

clue.text: A drink with male group highly regarded

parts.note: tea is a common drink

explanation.surface: An elite team gathers over a cup with a man.
explanation.definitionFit: The A-team is the first-choice squad, those rated most highly.

clue.text: Mischief-maker simply hides

indicators.note: hides says the word simply conceals the letters within it

explanation.surface: A prankster simply goes into hiding.
explanation.definitionFit: An imp is a small devil or a naughty child who causes trouble.

clue.text: Fellow, one with a yen to conceal name like a lunatic

parts.note: a fellow is a man
the Roman numeral I is one

indicators.note: to conceal means to keep inside, so the name is tucked within the a-plus-yen letters

parts.note: Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese yen
to call is to name

explanation.surface: A man with a longing to keep a name secret behaves madly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yen' looks like a longing but is the currency, Y; CALL sits between A and Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting maniacally means behaving in a wild, crazed way, as a madman would.

clue.text: Chum getting married gets a bit of a hand

parts.note: a chum is a pal

explanation.surface: A friend weds and receives a little applause.
explanation.definitionFit: The palm is the inner part of the hand, a portion of it.

clue.text: Humble revolutionary, a writer

parts.note: Che Guevara is the archetypal revolutionary
a pen is a writing instrument

explanation.surface: A modest radical turns out to be an author.
explanation.definitionFit: To cheapen someone is to lower or degrade them, as humbling does.

clue.text: "Amen" is thus possibly seen to indicate fervour

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Saying Amen at a service is taken as a sign of zeal.
explanation.definitionFit: Enthusiasm and fervour are both words for intense eagerness.

clue.text: Countries with no stain, having been transformed

indicators.note: transformed means changed in form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: States cleansed of a stain after a makeover.
explanation.definitionFit: Nations are countries, peoples organised as states.

clue.text: Settled in Rome, dear Greek princess

indicators.note: settled in says the name lies lodged within the following words

explanation.surface: A letter to a loved one who has made a home in Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Medea, daughter of King Aeetes of Colchis, was a princess who helped Jason.

clue.text: Bold action going wrong, restricted by strange uprising

indicators.note: restricted by means hemmed in by, so one piece sits within the other
in a down clue an uprising reads from the bottom up, so the word for strange runs backwards

parts.note: odd means strange
erring means going wrong

explanation.surface: A daring deed goes awry, hampered by a peculiar revolt.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'uprising' means reading upwards, so the word for strange runs backwards and wraps the word for going wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Derring-do is heroic, daring conduct, the stuff of adventure stories.

clue.text: Community of women, about 50, in NY district

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the first piece goes round the number

parts.note: a harem is the women of a household in some traditions
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A group of women, around fifty strong, living in a New York neighbourhood.
explanation.definitionFit: Harlem is a well-known neighbourhood in upper Manhattan, New York City.

clue.text: Old port in which masonry's crumbled — nothing's left!

indicators.note: crumbled stonework falls into pieces, so the word's letters are rearranged
left means gone away, so the round letter for zero departs

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: An ancient harbour town whose stonework has fallen down, leaving nothing standing.
explanation.walkthrough: Shuffle MASONRY and remove its O ('nothing's left') to get the six letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Smyrna was the ancient name of the Aegean seaport now called Izmir in Turkey.

clue.text: We'd moved into a bit of fog in central part of America

indicators.note: into says the scrambled letters are put inside the other piece

parts.note: mist is a light fog

indicators.note: moved means shifted about, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Travellers drove into a patch of fog in the American heartland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moved' looks like travel in the surface, but it signals the jumbling of We'd.
explanation.definitionFit: The Midwest is the north-central region of the United States.

clue.text: Maiden given alternative family role

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
other means alternative, as in the other option

explanation.surface: A young woman takes on a different part in the household.
explanation.definitionFit: Being a mum is one of the parts a person plays within a family.

clue.text: Thus party is positioned by motorway, bad place

parts.note: so means thus
a do is a party
M is the UK abbreviation for motorway, as in the M1

explanation.surface: A party held beside a motorway is therefore a grim venue.
explanation.definitionFit: Sodom is the biblical city destroyed for its wickedness, a byword for a sinful place.

clue.text: Idiots, not right to display heavenly bodies

indicators.note: not right says the letter for right is dropped

parts.note: morons are idiots

explanation.surface: Fools getting it wrong when showing off the stars.
explanation.definitionFit: Moons are natural satellites, celestial bodies orbiting planets.

clue.text: The police, getting on, brought to account

parts.note: someone getting on is ageing, growing old
a bill is an account of money owed

explanation.surface: Ageing police officers are finally made to answer for themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Bill is British slang for the police force.

clue.text: Violent action against hospital in old city

indicators.note: violent suggests the letters are thrown about into a new order

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: Brutal moves against a hospital in an ancient town.
explanation.definitionFit: Antioch was an ancient city in Syria, now Antakya in Turkey.

clue.text: Starter of tongue in container

indicators.note: starter of points to the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A tongue starter served in a pot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Starter' hints at a first course, but it means the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A tin is a metal can or box used for holding things.

clue.text: Thus there is hesitation to travel

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitation
to go is to travel

explanation.surface: So someone dithers over whether to make the trip.
explanation.definitionFit: Ergo is Latin for therefore, a formal synonym in arguments.

clue.text: The giving of aid in small HQ around end of December

parts.note: mini means small

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the headquarters word encloses the letter

parts.note: a station is a base or headquarters, as for police

indicators.note: end of picks the last letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Aid is given from a little base at the close of the year.
explanation.definitionFit: Ministration means providing help or care, especially to the needy.
